title: Theme
description: A color and icon theme. A theme is based on the built-in 'dark' or 'light' theme: any color or icon it does not list is taken from that base. Used for the built-in themes, the themes you create, and theme export/import files.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique, stable id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. 'dark' and 'light' are the built-in themes.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the theme list.

base.title: Base
base.description: Built-in theme that supplies every color not set here, and decides the system control style (light or dark).

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Color of each element, by token. Only the ones you list differ from the base theme.

background.title: Window background
background.description: Background behind everything else. Group: Window. CSS variable: --bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

text.title: Text
text.description: Main text and icon color. Group: Window. CSS variable: --text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

textMuted.title: Secondary text
textMuted.description: Less important text: hints, times, counts. Group: Window. CSS variable: --muted. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

border.title: Borders
border.description: Lines around panels, buttons, inputs and dialogs. Group: Window. CSS variable: --border. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Primary buttons, switched-on toggles and slider handles. Group: Window. CSS variable: --accent. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

accentBorder.title: Accent outline
accentBorder.description: Outline of accent elements. Group: Window. CSS variable: --accent-border. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

accentText.title: Text on accent
accentText.description: Text and icons on accent-colored buttons. Group: Window. CSS variable: --accent-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

buttonBackground.title: Button
buttonBackground.description: Background of ordinary buttons. Group: Buttons. CSS variable: --button-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

buttonHover.title: Button under the mouse
buttonHover.description: Background of a button while the pointer is over it. Group: Buttons. CSS variable: --button-hover. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

buttonText.title: Button text
buttonText.description: Text and icons on ordinary buttons. Group: Buttons. CSS variable: --button-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: Playlist panel, dialogs and notices. Group: Panels. CSS variable: --panel. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

panelRaised.title: Raised surface
panelRaised.description: Text fields, menus and drop-downs. Group: Panels. CSS variable: --panel-2. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

badgesBackground.title: Playlist badge column
badgesBackground.description: Background of the narrow column with the round playlist badges. Group: Panels. CSS variable: --badges-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

badgeText.title: Badge text
badgeText.description: Initials inside a playlist badge. Group: Panels. CSS variable: --badge-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

badgeActiveBorder.title: Selected badge outline
badgeActiveBorder.description: Ring around the selected playlist badge. Group: Panels. CSS variable: --badge-active. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

playerBackground.title: Video area
playerBackground.description: Background around the video picture. Group: Player. CSS variable: --player-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

controlsBackground.title: Control bar
controlsBackground.description: Background of the play/seek/volume bar. Group: Player. CSS variable: --controls-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

controlsText.title: Control bar text
controlsText.description: Text and icons in the control bar. Group: Player. CSS variable: --controls-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

progressTrack.title: Progress track
progressTrack.description: The empty part of progress bars. Group: Player. CSS variable: --progress-track. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

progressBar.title: Progress bar
progressBar.description: The filled part of progress bars. Group: Player. CSS variable: --progress-bar. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

overlayBackground.title: Message over the video
overlayBackground.description: Background of messages shown over the picture, such as playback errors. Group: Player. CSS variable: --overlay-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

overlayText.title: Text over the video
overlayText.description: Text color of messages over the picture. Group: Player. CSS variable: --overlay-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

trackCurrent.title: Playing track
trackCurrent.description: Highlight of the track that is playing. Group: Playlist. CSS variable: --track-current. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

trackHover.title: Track under the mouse
trackHover.description: Background of a track row while the pointer is over it. Group: Playlist. CSS variable: --track-hover. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

rowStripe.title: Alternate list rows
rowStripe.description: Every second row in lists. Group: Playlist. CSS variable: --row-stripe. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

rowSelected.title: Selected list row
rowSelected.description: Background of the selected playlist in the manager. Group: Playlist. CSS variable: --row-selected. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

thumbBackground.title: Preview background
thumbBackground.description: Background behind preview images while they load. Group: Playlist. CSS variable: --thumb-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

dropIndicator.title: Reorder line
dropIndicator.description: Line showing where a dragged track will land. Group: Playlist. CSS variable: --drop-indicator. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

backdrop.title: Dialog backdrop
backdrop.description: Dimming behind dialogs. Group: Dialogs and overlays. CSS variable: --backdrop. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Shadow under menus. Group: Dialogs and overlays. CSS variable: --shadow. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

dropHintBackground.title: Drop hint
dropHintBackground.description: Overlay shown while files are dragged over the window. Group: Dialogs and overlays. CSS variable: --drop-hint-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

errorText.title: Error text
errorText.description: Error messages and destructive menu entries. Group: Messages and warnings. CSS variable: --error-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

warningText.title: Warning text
warningText.description: Warnings, such as a video without its audio file. Group: Messages and warnings. CSS variable: --warning-text. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

dangerBackground.title: Danger button
dangerBackground.description: Background of buttons that delete things. Group: Messages and warnings. CSS variable: --danger-bg. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

dangerBorder.title: Danger button outline
dangerBorder.description: Outline of buttons that delete things. Group: Messages and warnings. CSS variable: --danger-border. Format #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa to make it transparent (aa = opacity, 00 invisible to ff solid).

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Icon of each slot. Only the ones you list differ from the default icons.

play.title: Play
play.description: Start playback. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

pause.title: Pause
pause.description: Pause playback. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

rewind.title: Back 10 seconds
rewind.description: Jump back in the video. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

forward.title: Forward 10 seconds
forward.description: Jump forward in the video. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

loopVideo.title: Loop video
loopVideo.description: Repeat the current video. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

fullscreen.title: Enter fullscreen
fullscreen.description: Switch to fullscreen. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

fullscreenExit.title: Leave fullscreen
fullscreenExit.description: Leave fullscreen. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

volumeUp.title: Volume high
volumeUp.description: Volume slider with a high volume. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

volumeDown.title: Volume low
volumeDown.description: Volume slider with a low volume. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

volumeOff.title: Muted
volumeOff.description: Muted or zero volume. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

capturePreview.title: Use frame as preview
capturePreview.description: Save the current frame as the video's preview. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

playlistLoop.title: Playlist loop
playlistLoop.description: Repeat the whole playlist. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

addPlaylist.title: New playlist
addPlaylist.description: Create a playlist. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

settings.title: Settings and manager
settings.description: Open the playlist manager. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

more.title: More actions
more.description: Open the menu of a track. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

grip.title: Reorder handle
grip.description: Handle for dragging a track. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

panelHideLeft.title: Hide panel (panel on the left)
panelHideLeft.description: Tab that hides the playlist panel when it is on the left. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

panelShowLeft.title: Show panel (panel on the left)
panelShowLeft.description: Tab that shows the playlist panel when it is on the left. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

panelHideRight.title: Hide panel (panel on the right)
panelHideRight.description: Tab that hides the playlist panel when it is on the right. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".

panelShowRight.title: Show panel (panel on the right)
panelShowRight.description: Tab that shows the playlist panel when it is on the right. Value is "<icon set>:<icon name>"; sets are "builtin" and "icomoon".
